card.title: Your Risk, My Cost
card.instruction: Treat every choice around you as a risk whose consequences may land on you. Press for a voice in decisions you cannot control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thirty people camping in our garden? I maintain that lawn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Followed by six Saturdays of reseeding. I want a say in tent placement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Put them wherever you like, but leave room for the fire pit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I need a say in that too. You've given me the seating plan for my next repair job.

mechanism: A treats garden-party arrangements as future maintenance liabilities and presses for control over them.
confusable: Unlike possessiveness about space, A must connect decisions to repair labor landing personally on A.
comparison: S208-b broadens granted placement authority when the fire pit appears; S208-a insists cleanup includes replacement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
